title: MVE
description: Maxon's Vanilla Experiance. A Vanilla Pack Focusing on Performance and on QoL
body:
This modpack is built to enhance performance and introduce a handful of quality-of-life improvements — all while keeping the pure vanilla Minecraft experience completely intact.

It includes client-side mods only, focused on optimizing game speed, stability, and responsiveness. You won't find any new blocks, items, biomes, or gameplay changes here — the goal is to make Minecraft run smoother and feel better, without altering how it plays.

Every included mod has been chosen for its compatibility and reliability, ensuring a seamless vanilla experience enhanced only by technical improvements such as frame rate boosts, reduced stuttering, faster world loading, and improved UI responsiveness.

If you're looking for a pack that makes Minecraft perform its best while still feeling entirely vanilla, this modpack delivers exactly that.

Please note that not all servers allow every client-side mod. Make sure to check server rules before joining. Following Mods are forbidden by most servers:

- [Flashback](https://modrinth.com/mod/flashback)
- [Freecam](https://modrinth.com/mod/freecam)
